annotations.title: Audit ten pages of a site

description: Audit up to ten pages of one site in a run: the address given plus pages spread across its sitemap (or linked from it), each checked for whether it answers, may be indexed, and has its own title, description, H1 and canonical — reporting broken pages, a stray noindex, titles and descriptions copied across pages, canonicals that point elsewhere and thin pages, with a table of the pages and their facts (`pages`, to compare one run against the next). It reads each page as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after the site's robots.txt, a few at a time, and stores nothing. At most 3 audits an hour per site, besides at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The site to check (https://example.com). Any URL on it means its whole site.

name: audit_site

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
